verdict.rationale: Rippling documents its own APIs for building custom apps across HR, IT, and finance. It also provides developer docs, a sandbox, an llms.txt, and an official CLI, though the CLI is scoped to creating and deploying Rippling-hosted integrations. Nothing shows the API covers what the UI can do, such as running payroll, approving pay runs, managing benefits enrollment, or building reports. missing for 10: evidence of API parity with UI actions, endpoint coverage documentation for payroll/benefits/time/permissions operations, independent or hands-on confirmation of API breadth.
